title: SUMB - Software Update Menu Bar (fr.jeremyb.sumb)
description: Managed settings for SUMB, a companion menu bar app for scheduled macOS updates deployed via blueprints/DDM. Preference domain: fr.jeremyb.sumb. Requires macOS 15.0 or later.

hideIconWhenUpToDate.title: Hide Menu Bar Icon When Up to Date
hideIconWhenUpToDate.description: Remove the SUMB icon from the menu bar when the Mac is up to date.

disableContextMenuActions.title: Disable Context Menu Actions
disableContextMenuActions.description: Prevent users from accessing the Settings menu.

ignoreAppleUpdateChannel.title: Ignore Apple Update Channel
ignoreAppleUpdateChannel.description: Ignore updates coming from the standard Apple software update channel and only take managed update declarations (DDM) into account.

notificationsEnabled.title: Enable Notifications
notificationsEnabled.description: Allow SUMB to post reminder notifications about the scheduled macOS update.

reminderThresholdDays.title: Reminder Threshold (days)
reminderThresholdDays.description: Number of days remaining before the update deadline at which SUMB starts sending reminder notifications.

reminderIntervalMinutes.title: Reminder Interval (minutes)
reminderIntervalMinutes.description: Time in minutes between two reminder notifications.

reminderNotificationTitle.title: Reminder Notification Title
reminderNotificationTitle.description: Title displayed in the reminder notification.

reminderNotificationBody.title: Reminder Notification Body
reminderNotificationBody.description: Body text of the reminder notification. Supports the $VERSION and $DATE variables, which are replaced by the scheduled macOS version and the deadline date.
reminderNotificationBody.default: An update to macOS $VERSION has been scheduled for $DATE.

localizedPopoverTitle.title: Popover Title
localizedPopoverTitle.description: Title shown at the top of the popover displayed when the user clicks the menu bar icon.

localizedRestartWarning.title: Restart Warning
localizedRestartWarning.description: Warning text shown in the popover about the automatic restart at the deadline. Markdown links are supported, for example: [Learn more...](https://example.com)
localizedRestartWarning.default: Be aware that your Mac will automatically restart after the deadline. [Learn more...](https://support.apple.com/en-us/100100)

localizedUpdateNowButton.title: Update Now Button Label
localizedUpdateNowButton.description: Label of the button that takes the user to Software Update.

localizedUpToDateMessage.title: Up to Date Message
localizedUpToDateMessage.description: Message displayed in the popover when the Mac is up to date.
localizedUpToDateMessage.default: Your Mac is up to date.

localizedUpdatingMenuBar.title: Updating Menu Bar Text
localizedUpdatingMenuBar.description: Text shown in the menu bar while the update is being prepared.

localizedDaySuffix.title: Day Suffix
localizedDaySuffix.description: Suffix appended to the number of days remaining in the menu bar countdown. Use "j" in French, "t" in German, and so on.
